review_findings.problem: Source numbers and different receiving recipes were being used to support separate partial stock owners with no demonstrated material distinction.
review_findings.challenge: Compare PCR-S11/NOS 0.1 N NaOH, JCM574/PBBM 1 M KH2PO4, ATCC1340/chopped-meat nominal 1 N NaOH, and ATCC1942/JCM 5% sulfide. Neither unknown carrier nor source numbering proves distinctness; nominal concentration alone also does not prove equivalence.
review_findings.resolution: Four weaker duplicate candidates are withdrawn from the active proposal set. Concrete source anchors remain, with explicit conditional comparisons and no exact assignment of unsupported occurrences. PBBM/ATCC 2.5% sulfide comparison was also checked and remains conditional.

review_findings.problem: No-delta judgments missed unsafe concentration or wrong-compound aliases on the existing KH2PO4, sulfide-nonahydrate and Tris owners.
review_findings.resolution: Three bounded payloads reject the specific unsafe aliases while preserving text, sources, chemistry, roles, counts and histories. The Tris payload explicitly supersedes the original four-HCl-rejection proposal and retains its original case/evidence. Six applicability sentences were clarified so no-extra-parsing-alias reasoning does not contradict these separate owner repairs.
review_findings.consumer_scope: Independent exact frozen CSV lookup confirms four concentration-qualified phosphate/sulfide labels uniquely resolve to pure owners. The standalone (dibasic) token is absent as an exact CSV row, so no consumer-resolution claim is made for that fragment. Tris work remains under issue1157.

review_findings.problem: The same molybdate-dihydrate owner retained ten additional malformed or form-unspecified formula aliases after rejecting the assigned malformed label.
review_findings.resolution: The final v8 owner payload rejects the ten additional literal formulas, retains the original rejection and preserves all exact text/source/history. The inspected historical merge/backfill assertions do not establish source-qualified universal identity. No corrected chemical is inferred for any occurrence, and the original source-form hold remains.

review_findings.finding: Both narrower supplied-form to generic-parent proposals used BROAD_MATCH, reversing the authoritative relation. MAPPING_SEMANTICS requires NARROW_MATCH to emit broadMatch.
review_findings.resolution: Exact successor mapping_quality is NARROW_MATCH; source identity and limited parent scope retained.

review_findings.finding: Neutral PQQ was inferred from absent salt specification; supplier nomenclature contrast does not establish the NBRC supplied form.
review_findings.resolution: Exact acid proposal withdrawn; source-form uncertainty and separate dose defect retained.

review_findings.problem: Eight B12/K1 stock cases were withheld solely because carrier or percent basis was unknown despite explicit source preparation context.
review_findings.resolution: Six partial source-bound preparation anchors; generic vitamin components, unknown carriers omitted, unspecified percent basis not converted, same-strength other recipes conditional only.

review_findings.problem: Shared NBRC 1020/824 vitamin preparation notes incorrectly attributed vitamin filtration to both.
review_findings.resolution: Actual NBRC 824 excludes only other reagents from autoclaving; final payload scopes filtration to NBRC 1020 and limits shared identity to enumerated input stock formula. Prior history retained with explicit correction.

review_findings.problem: Thauers no-change decision treated actual stock formula as unavailable although direct TOGO source comments establish preparation and an internal pantothenate transcription conflict.
review_findings.resolution: Recovered direct recipe plus original CultureBotHT assertion provenance are kept separate. Existing-owner narrow notes/history proposal records formula/protocol and unresolved bridge without inventing a duplicate owner or endorsing exact form equivalence.

root_scope: All 133 original no-change cases plus 2 inherited-case supersession bindings have authorship-separated scientific appraisal; original reviews retained for the other53 cases. Exact case and payload review content was read before selection. Integration and source-hold release remain excluded.
